description: Implementation of a Stream class adhering to PSR-7 StreamInterface, managing PHP stream resources with methods for reading, writing, seeking, and metadata handling.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A class implementing PSR-7 StreamInterface to handle PHP stream resources with additional features like caching and pipe detection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream object with a PHP resource and optional cache stream, validating the resource and cache properties.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for the underlying stream, optionally for a specific key.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a new PHP resource as the stream, detaching any existing one.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the current stream resource and resets internal state.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream contents as a string, using cache if available.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Determines if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Determines if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: isPipe
methods.description: Detects if the stream is a pipe.
